description: Lets the agent save files for the user (reports, documents, downloads) into that user's own data folder and read them back — instead of writing into the codebase.
skill_summary: How to hand files to the user with save_file (into their own data home) and read them back — and why deliverables and scratch must never be written into the codebase. Load before producing any report, document, export, chart, or download for the user.
